packageRules.description: main requires signed commits and linear history. platformCommit is set to auto: as a GitHub App Renovate commits through the GitHub API and GitHub signs them, while with a personal access token it falls back to local git commits, which are signed by the developer's own configured key. Forcing enabled would break local runs, because API commits with a PAT are not signed.
Go dependencies are runtime code; surface them as fixes so git-cliff groups them under Bug Fixes.

k8s.io/kube-openapi uses pseudo-versions, so Renovate cannot tell that newer snapshots switch major versions of shared types. Bumping it independently of k8s.io/* breaks the build: k8s v0.37.x pins structured-merge-diff/v6, while newer kube-openapi snapshots moved to /v7. Move this in lockstep with the k8s.io/* minor, not on its own.
Toolchain and language version bumps are chores, not fixes.
Keep all GitHub Actions pins together so one PR updates the whole workflow set.
OpenTofu providers move together; they are additive and validated by CI.
CLI tools installed via curl in workflows and the Taskfile.
Container images are digest-pinned; major bumps need a manual look.

Trivy and the scanner version pinned in workflows. pinDigests is off because these are the 'version:' inputs of the action, which name a tool release rather than a container image, so there is no digest to pin. Leaving pinDigests on makes Renovate attempt a digest pin, fail re-extraction with 'Digest is not updated', and abort the branch with 'update failure'.

GoReleaser's 'version:' input under goreleaser-action picks a GoReleaser release, not a container image. It has no digest, so the global pinDigests setting makes Renovate attempt a digest pin that cannot succeed, failing the branch with 'update failure'. The action itself is still digest-pinned by the github-actions manager.

MegaLinter is pinned in three places that must move together: the image version (MEGALINTER_VERSION), the image digest (MEGALINTER_IMAGE_DIGEST) and the npm runner (MEGALINTER_RUNNER_VERSION) that .github/scripts/mega-linter-runner executes. Grouping them stops the version and digest drifting apart: a version-only bump changes the reported label while the pinned digest still runs the old image, because MEGALINTER_IMAGE is built from the digest and the runner's --image overrides --release. separateMultipleMajor is off so a vN bump lands in one PR instead of splitting across branches. pinDigests is off because the GitHub release version has no image digest to add. This rule must stay after the cli tools and container images rules so it overrides their grouping.

customManagers.description: git-cliff, pinned by curl in release workflows. The version appears twice in the URL, so the whole match is templated.
ko, pinned by curl in CI. The version appears twice in the URL, so the whole match is templated.
Helm, pinned by curl in release and CI workflows.
kind, pinned by curl in the e2e job.
Trivy binary version passed to trivy-action.

ko base image digest in .ko.yaml. GoReleaser sets the same value in .goreleaser.yml, but that one is pinned by digest too and updated separately below. currentDigest must capture the 'sha256:' prefix because the docker datasource reports newDigest with that prefix; capturing the bare hex and re-adding 'sha256:' in the template yields 'sha256:sha256:...' and Renovate then fails the branch with 'update failure'.

kos base_image digest in .goreleaser.yml, which must stay in sync with .ko.yaml. currentDigest captures the 'sha256:' prefix so it matches the docker datasource's newDigest format and re-extraction still succeeds after replacement.

Task CLI version passed to go-task/setup-task. Pinned exactly rather than as 3.x, because a floating range makes the action resolve the newest release through the GitHub API at runtime and fail with 'unable to get latest version' when that call is rate limited.
Argo CD Operator revision pinned in the Taskfile.
MegaLinter release version. Tracked against GitHub releases; it is not a container tag.

MegaLinter runner version, used as 'npx mega-linter-runner@<version>'. It ships in lockstep with the MegaLinter release but lives on npm, not GitHub releases, so it needs its own datasource and would otherwise never be updated.

prek version in CONTRIBUTING.md's Prerequisites. Renovate has no Markdown manager, so these drifted several releases behind what the workflows actually pin. One customManager is needed per tool because depNameTemplate cannot vary within a single manager.

MegaLinter image digest, tracked against the container repository. currentDigest captures the 'sha256:' prefix so the in-place substitution matches the docker datasource's newDigest format; with a bare hex capture the result becomes 'sha256:sha256:...' and the branch fails with 'update failure'. This manager has no autoReplaceStringTemplate, so Renovate substitutes currentDigest for newDigest inside the matched text.
